items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I played at the Hardenburg Hotel more than one time with Eisen Morgan.

ctx.x: Did you play, what kind of places did you used to play in then? Halls. Halls. Most of them were there. Everything was Halls.

Everything was Halls. Everything was Halls. Halls was a big hotel. He'd get big hotel. I played at the Hardenburg Hotel more than one time with Eisen Morgan. That was a fine hotel. It was a big dance crowd. Yeah. Where is that? Hallsburg, Mississippi on Mobile Street. Was it all different, white and colored places? Which one? On Mobile?
All over, I mean where you're traveling. He played white and colored. Yeah, it was all different places.
